notes: Wrap-up car - product security audit (owner items #14 and #15). Four audit waves over the browser surface, settings and disk writes, channel/tool-injection paths, and the desktop shell plus deployment scripts produced 15 findings; triage adopted six fixes and documented nine non-issues. The six: a loopback Host allow-list on the console (DNS-rebinding requests now get 403), component-wise static path containment, every persisted URL field refusing embedded credentials (console settings, the upstream and MCP parsers, and the setup wizard - which also redacts any userinfo before printing), atomic writes through a random sibling file created with O_EXCL and O_NOFOLLOW (secret files are now created 0600, never briefly umask-readable), strict integer validation for the desktop port env var, an optional HMAC-signed /api/health challenge that the desktop shell verifies with a timing-safe compare before loading the console origin, and shell-quoting of every dynamic value in the tmux boot strings. A post-fix re-review then caught one more issue (W5a-01): a structurally broken authority made the URL parser raise, which either dropped the connection or - on two fields - let a credential-bearing string past the check; parsing now fails closed on every path, and the final re-review returned zero findings. Owner item #15 (.pi archive) shipped earlier on its own private branch.
